scope: 16 Jedi Academy character-scale weapon claims only. No rolling authority mutation. No production mutation authorization.
inherits: Galaxy at War Phase 2C schema extensions

sourcePolicy.visualAuthority: SW Saga - Jedi Academy Training Manual (optimized).pdf

schemaDelta.principle: Jedi Academy extends the normalized authority only where its published weapon mechanics cannot be represented faithfully by the schema through Clone Wars. No production migration is authorized.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.wieldingRules[] for source-defined handedness, effective-size choices, ability-bonus substitutions, and wielder-size-dependent eligibility.
why: Archaic/modern lightfoils may count as Small when beneficial and cannot be wielded two-handed.
Great lightsaber gates certain feat/talent interactions by wielder size rather than prohibiting smaller wielders outright.
Long-handle lightsaber offers a two-handed choice between doubled Strength and 2d10 base damage.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append wieldingRules:[] by default. Backfill already-certified Core/KOTOR/Force Unleashed handedness or effective-size exceptions without inferring from weapon names or repo tags.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.stateMachine for forced timed transitions between weapon states, including duration, forced next state, and lockouts.
why: Retrosaber transitions normal -> 2d10 overcharge -> forced 2d4 burnout for one round -> normal, and cannot be dialed up during burnout.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append stateMachine:null by default. Existing selectable modes remain modeProfiles unless they have forced temporal transitions.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].activationRequirements[] and equivalent mode/quality gates for feat, size, wielding, or choice prerequisites.
why: Long Haft Form alone unlocks the extra haft-end/double-weapon profiles on the long-handle lightsaber and lightsaber pike.
The great lightsaber has wielder-size-gated feat/talent interaction.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append [] by default. Backfill already-certified conditional profiles and modes rather than making them always available.

requiredEdits.change: Expand conditionalModifiers[].target beyond attack/damage to structured defenses, skill checks, and cumulative check penalties.
why: Crossguard lightsaber changes Block cumulative Use the Force penalties from -5 to -2 and separately imposes -2 on Deflect.
Dual-phase extended mode imposes -2 Reflex Defense only against adjacent attackers.
Guard shoto grants +2 equipment to Use the Force checks for Block/Deflect.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Keep the existing conditionalModifiers[] container but normalize target vocabulary across all prior books. Do not create ad hoc prose-only numeric modifiers.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].triggeredEffects[] plus modifierPolicy for delayed/repeated damage or control effects and for explicitly included/excluded damage modifiers.
why: Lightwhip can initiate grab/grapple on hit and deals base weapon damage at end of a held target turn while excluding Strength, half heroic level, and all other modifiers.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append triggeredEffects:[] by default. Backfill already-certified recurring effects such as Clone Wars Garrote and condition-triggered bonus damage only where the source clearly specifies timing.

requiredEdits.change: Extend stun authority with activation {timing, action} so a per-attack stun choice is distinct from a persistent alternate setting.
why: San-ni staff lets the wielder designate the energy couplings at the time the attack is made, with no swift-action mode switch.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Backfill prior stun weapons with source-correct timing: persistent setting, per-attack declaration, native stun-only, or ammunition-dependent. Do not assume every Yes table entry uses the same action economy.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.constructionRules for weapon-specific construction DCs, crystal/effect inheritance, and mutually exclusive construction configurations.
why: Dual-phase lightsaber can use one crystal across both phases or replace the extended phase with a second crystal whose effect is mutually exclusive with the default crystal.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append constructionRules:null by default. Populate only where a weapon source explicitly publishes construction mechanics.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.configurationStates[] for noncombat physical states with transition action and usability/storage effects.
why: Wan-shen breaks into four Small objects and requires a full-round action to assemble/disassemble.
Archaic lightsaber power cord can become disconnected from its external power pack.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append configurationStates:[] by default. Backfill source-certified cases such as Clone Wars Snap Baton and Czerka Adventurer where useful.

schemaDelta.sourceQualityRule: Jedi Academy does not introduce a new Accurate/Inaccurate/Arc definition in these 16 claims. Do not import repo traits as source qualities. All lightsaber identities retain the Core lightsaber outgoing DR-bypass rule unless a later explicit exception applies to the attack itself.

verification.retrosaberSidebar: Holocron Lesson p.50 visually verified; Retrosaber is not separately tabled

bookLocalGuardrails: Do not update a rolling/master weapon authority from this package.
Do not mutate production packs, template/schema runtime, actors, feats, or talents during certification.
Do not create San-Ni Staff or Wan-Shen during this phase.
Repo fields are comparison evidence only.
Do not infer Retrosaber cost, weight, size, or availability from the current repo; this source does not separately table them.
Do not treat generic repo tags such as Throwable, Finesse, Duelist, Large-Only, or TwoHanded as canonical unless the published entry establishes that exact mechanic.
Guard Shoto, Lightsaber Pike, and Long-Handle Lightsaber are cross-published identities; this book-local package certifies only the Jedi Academy claim.
Discblade return-to-hand is not a base weapon quality; it depends on trained Zeison Sha Force use.
